ui.label: PASSIVE_MODE

ui.helperText: Enable EPSV command in passive mode for IPv4 networks.

ui.label: REMOTE_VERIFICATION_ENABLED
ui.helperText: Verify remote hostname/IP in passive mode responses to detect misrouting.

ui.label: SERVER_SYSTEM_KEY
ui.helperText: Server system type used for parsing directory listings.

ui.label: IGNORE_EMPTY_FILES
ui.helperText: true->Ignores replication for empty files, false->Replicates empty files too

ui.label: TRUST_STORE_PATH
ui.helperText: Path to the truststore containing trusted CA certificates to validate the FTPS server.

ui.label: DEFAULT_FILE_TRANSFER_TYPE
ui.helperText: Default file transfer mode. Use BINARY to avoid data corruption.

ui.label: SERVER_TIMEZONE
ui.helperText: Timezone of the FTP server used for parsing timestamps.

ui.label: WILDCARD_TYPE
ui.helperText: 0 -> disabled 1 -> whitelist 2 -> blacklist

ui.label: SERVER_PORT
ui.helperText: FTP server port number. The default port is 21 for plain FTP; use 990 for implicit FTPS. Ensure the port matches the server's configuration to establish successful connections.

ui.label: ENABLED
ui.helperText: Set this value to 0 to disable and 1 to enable FTP/FTPs source location. Default 0, the file will be searched for on the local source machine and if set to 1, the files will be pulled from a remote location on the ftp server. Enabling this shifts the connector from local file system operations to remote FTP/FTPs interactions, allowing integration with external servers for file polling, listing, and transfer.

ui.label: ADAPTER_ID
ui.helperText: unique ID for the connector

ui.label: SERVER_PASSWORD
ui.helperText: FTP user password. The password corresponding to the username for server authentication. For security, store this in a secure vault or environment variable rather than plaintext configuration.

ui.label: FILE_TYPE
ui.helperText: type of file (1 -> static 2 -> Dynamic 3 -> Directory first level 4 -> Directory recursive)

ui.label: IMPLICIT_FTPS
ui.helperText: Use implicit FTPS mode (typically port 990). Entire session is encrypted from the start. Effective only when useFTPS=true.

ui.label: CLEAR_STATE_ON_EOD
ui.helperText: (0 -> doesn't clear state in LVQ 1 -> clears state in LVQ)

ui.label: RESTART_TIME_SEC
ui.helperText: integer value representing number of seconds between each restart

ui.label: COPY_FILE_MODE_PERMISSIONS
ui.helperText: (0 -> do not copy 1 -> copy)

ui.label: SERVER_IP
ui.helperText: FTP Server IP. Specify the hostname or IP address of the remote FTP/FTPs server to connect to. This is required when enabled is true; empty value defaults to local file system if not set.

ui.label: EOD_TIME_SEC
ui.helperText: -1 -> disabled 0 -> midnight time  (Hours to Seconds) - connector will check if configured time has passed number of seconds and exits.

ui.label: ACTIVE_MIN_PORT
ui.helperText: Minimum local port for active mode data connections (0 for system-assigned).

ui.label: TRACE_ENABLED
ui.helperText: Enable detailed FTP command/response tracing. Logs all FTP protocol exchanges at TRACE level via SLF4J disable in production to reduce log volume.

ui.label: USE_FTPS
ui.helperText: Enables FTPS (TLS-secured FTP) for encrypted control and data channels. Requires proper SSL/TLS configuration.

ui.label: TRUST_STORE_PASSWORD
ui.helperText: Password for the truststore file; required when trustStorePath is provided.

ui.label: ACTIVE_MAX_PORT
ui.helperText: Maximum local port for active mode data connections. Must be >= activeMinPort.

ui.label: SERVER_USERNAME
ui.helperText: FTP user username. The credentials for authenticating with the FTP server. Anonymous access may use 'anonymous' if supported by the server, but a valid username is typically required.

ui.label: API_PROPERTIES
ui.helperText: Number of connection retries per Solace host

false -> No file start event
